verification.note: PlayerLayer.tsx:239-261 attaches the wheel handler only to the layer frame in the parent document. For a provider iframe, the wheel reaches it only through GestureOverlay (frontend/src/components/player/MediaControls/GestureOverlay.tsx:45-46, absolute inset-0, pointerEvents auto only while interactive). Every e2e wheel case (player-layer-desktop.spec.ts:443-482, player-layer-wheel.spec.ts:40-122, player-layer-wheel-desktop.spec.ts:39-60) calls openFilePage, which loads file=video0000001 (player-layer.measure.ts:380) and waits for a <video> (line 383). No other spec under frontend/ that uses mouse.wheel or WheelEvent covers a .loft player.

PlayerLayer.tsx:247 returns only when |deltaX| > |deltaY|. Otherwise lines 252-259 call preventDefault and apply only scroller.scrollTop += deltaY*unit. Nothing applies deltaX, so the horizontal part of a mostly-vertical wheel is lost.

unspecified_scores.reason: A mouse wheel over the player on desktop jumps the canvas instantly where a wheel beside the player scrolls smoothly, so the user sees a small difference in feel and nothing is lost.
No element known today handles the wheel in script without CSS overflow, so the behavior only appears with a future control or addon and does not reach ordinary use now.
A diagonal trackpad scroll over the player drops its sideways part, which shows only when the slot's scroller can also scroll sideways, and that is rare on the file page.

specification_compliance: I7 (r7 revision): vertical wheel forwarding exists for wheels that reach the layer frame (PlayerLayer.tsx:240-261). It is checked in a real browser only for a native video, not for a provider iframe through GestureOverlay.
regression_risks: The wheel forwarding for a .loft YouTube player through GestureOverlay can regress without any test failing.
test_coverage: The e2e wheel cases cover a native video only: openFilePage loads video0000001 (player-layer.measure.ts:380).
not_verified: I did not run any test or browser, so the claims are confirmed by reading the code only.
I did not check whether the wheel event bubbles from GestureOverlay to the layer frame under every wrapper element in LoftPlayer.
I did not check e2e specs outside frontend/ or the iOS Simulator runs.
